body_html:
When a room has to flex from a study station to a training session to a lunch service, the Global Duet stacking table keeps up. Its one-piece molded polypropylene worksurface shrugs off scratches and wipes clean in seconds, while a chrome-plated steel sled frame holds everything steady and stores away fast — five high on the floor, or up to 20 high on a dolly when the room needs to clear.

Features

  • One-piece injection-molded polypropylene top and modesty panel with a waterfall edge — scratch-resistant and easy to clean
  • Chrome-plated 0.5" solid steel sled frame for stability and a tidy footprint
  • Stacks five high on the floor and up to 20 high on a dolly for compact storage
  • Integrated ganging-frame option links tables into clean, continuous rows
  • Underside bumpers protect surfaces during stacking
  • Optional ADA-compliant frame available

Specifications

Overall dimensions are 29"W x 25"D x 28"H with a nominal 28"W x 18"D worksurface, shown here in Ivory Clouds. The Duet table exceeds ANSI/BIFMA standards and is offered in fifteen contemporary colours to match any space. Backed by a 5-year limited warranty on non-moving parts.

A genuinely Canadian-made table from a family-owned dealer serving Ontario institutions since 1964. Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are OECM-eligible suppliers, so school boards and public-sector buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote for volume pricing and lead times, or call 1-800-835-9565.
